children: Precious metals futures settle lower in cautious trading ahead of the Fed's interest-rate decision on Wednesday. "Elevated oil prices amid Middle East tensions and supply disruptions continued to fuel inflation fears and bolster bets on a Federal Reserve interest rate hike this week, keeping the yellow metal exposed to downside risk," Naga market analyst Frank Walbaum says in a note. "A hawkish Fed could further pull gold down, while any soft messaging may ease bets on hikes and help the metal recover." Front month gold slips 0.4% to $4.291.60 a troy ounce and silver settles down 0.4% at $63.236 a troy ounce. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
